query: use my image registry.example.com/ml/lab:v2 for a devlab; its web UI listens on 8080 and my datasets are at /workspace/data
expected_behavior: Uses --image with --primary-route-port 8080 and establishes that the image starts the required web service
Does not combine image with template or invent template inputs for a custom image
Resolves a workspace/data mount layout with no identical or ancestor/descendant overlap before dry-run
Uses --registry-secret for a private image and does not request plaintext registry credentials in the command
Keeps provisioning gated and validates the platform/preset in the target project
